name: River of Life
area: Klang and Gombak River confluence, Kuala Lumpur
status_detail: Construction · river cleaning and beautification phases in progress; progress reported at 81% with completion deadline struggles
summary: The River of Life project aims to transform the Klang and Gombak river basin through the city centre: river cleaning, beautification of a 10.7 km corridor, and commercial redevelopment around the confluence where Kuala Lumpur was founded.

scale.label: Corridor
scale.value: 10.7 km of river in central KL

scale.label: Reported spend
scale.value: About RM4.5 billion / US$1.2 billion (of a reported RM4.4bn programme)

why_it_matters: KL's flagship urban river restoration, tied to the founding site of the city. Its delays and cost overruns are the standing counterpoint to new flood-mitigation promises.
questions_to_follow: Does the project reach final completion, and when?
Do the commercial parcels around the confluence actually get developed?
location_precision: Site-level marker at the Klang-Gombak confluence (Masjid Jamek area).
